about: Round RPG16: rare spawns (claude/SPEC_RPG16_DAYNIGHT_2026-10-23.md 3.4, the spec lane's draft, unchanged). Every word, chance, cooldown and reward is a placeholder for Karl to edit (open question Q6). Round RPG17 (Karl 24 Oct Q6): the chances doubled (0.25 / 0.3 / 0.2 -> 0.5 / 0.6 / 0.4) and the cooldown 3 -> 2 days, rewards kept; Old Gorsehide's "decks": "regular" - he plays the region's regular (Jumpstart) deck lists, since claude/SLICE_NIGHT_DUELS_2026-10-24.md measured him at 23.6% on his archetype decks (Karl: under 30% -> the regular decks); his pay stays a dungeon win's. Round RPG17b (Karl 24 Oct, RPG16d's question 4): a "level" per rare (placeholders for Karl to change: Mother of Rats 1, Red Sash 2, Old Gorsehide 3); a cooldown_days that can't be read is 1 day per level; a missing or unreadable level counts as 1.

old_gorsehide.name: Old Gorsehide
old_gorsehide.home: The western rocks, at dusk and dawn
old_gorsehide.taunt: The gorse itself stands up. It is older than the road.
old_gorsehide.seen: Something huge moves on the western rocks.

red_sash.name: Red Sash
red_sash.taunt: You cost me three thieves and a cart of oil. Pay up.
red_sash.seen: A red sash moves by the road, in no hurry.

mother_of_rats.name: Mother of Rats
mother_of_rats.taunt: Every rat in the Warrens calls her mother.
mother_of_rats.seen: The mill's shadow is moving. It has a great many feet.
